text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the day of a massive maintenance 
overhaul for the track. Specialized 
maintenance vehicles came and went, and 
naturally, student use was strictly 
prohibited, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Do you happen to know how long this will 
take?
choice_data_list:
Um, if I remember correctly, the entire 
day...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving that single remark, she walked 
away. ...Could it be that even Mejiro 
Ramonu is taking the day off today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. The usual room, please. As for 
check-in time—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Inn Staff
text_block_list.text:
We've been expecting you. Will you be 
taking your bath immediately, as usual?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes. Just for ten minutes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Now... I don't have much time. Once the 
hot water loosens my body, next is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Not a bad breeze. Now then. Let us begin 
at a light pace—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Hah!

text_block_list.name: Hot Spring Resort Staff
text_block_list.text:
How is it, Ramonu-san? Our footbath! Feels 
amazing, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes. Please don't mind me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—With this, the fatigue in my leg muscles 
should dissipate nicely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—My body is relaxed, with no lingering 
fatigue. Everything is perfectly primed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Now... I wonder how preparations are going 
on their end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, the following day—the one who 
appeared on the newly maintained track 
earlier than anyone else was...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —How do I look?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
My spirit is roused, my body tuned, and 
all preparations made. Just enough to 
match your beautiful finish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Words are unrefined. If only the 
throbbing of this chest... could reach you 
through my legs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Here I go—haah!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ah, look! Isn't that Ramonu-san?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
She really is on a completely different 
level... Amazing as always...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...Is it really 'as always', I wonder? 
It's rare to see my sister this excited.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(It's almost as if it's right before an 
actual race—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Splendid. You truly respond to my 
yearning feelings with everything you 
have...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Shall we pick up the tempo even more? 
Dancing frantically, running through the 
night, endlessly, endlessly onward—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With every single step pounding into the 
ground, Mejiro Ramonu ran as if savoring 
the sheer ecstasy of galloping.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In her very silhouette, the absolute love 
she dedicated to racing seemed to 
manifest.
